content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm looking for advice on how to retrieve block status in [product_name] using [product_name] Web Editor. Specifically, I want to read the output status (digital 1 or 0) from an analog threshold trigger block—my example uses Block ID 079. How should I configure the variable in [product_name] Web Editor to access this block status directly? Currently, I'm using a flag after the block to get the status, but I wonder if there's a way to read it straight from the analog threshold trigger. Also, is it possible to obtain the digital output status from blocks like 'OR' or 'Latching Relay' without relying on flags? Thanks for any help!
It's not possible to directly access digital outputs from function blocks. You must use flags or digital network outputs to achieve this.
Yes, flags can be used and linked in [product_name] Web Editor. Direct reading of function block outputs isn't supported, but it can be done via VM-mappable function blocks.

There is no way to directly access the output of blocks like 'OR', 'Latching Relay', or an analog threshold trigger; instead, users must rely on flags or intermediary elements, as confirmed by forum responses.
